   This documents intent and function is to inform the user that NO legal
liabilities exist for the use of this software. Using any CNC machine is , 
at best, a hazardous operation. All safety precautions must be taken as 
machines can come to life at any time, software CAN malfucntion at any time, 
any user of the LazyCam software must understand and respect this, and must
delete the software immediately and not continue with installation unless 
they fully understand all implications of use, and the fact that no legal 
recourse exists in the case of wrongfull use, improper code, unexpected 
movement, or any damage caused by the afore mentioned effects. 

0. Useage limitations

A user may, for his own personal use , use the software license for LazyCam 
on as many computers as he owns and thereby drive as many machines as he owns. 
In a comercial environment, each machine must have its own license key file.  
A license may be used to activate the program for simulation use 
(not driving a machine) on as many computers as the registrant owns 
regardless of whether it is used in a commercial environment or not.
